topic: Someone finds their childhood teddy bear at a yard sale
text: Well now, ain't that something right fine? Found yer old bear at a yard sale, ye say? Must feel like a homecoming, don't it? When I plant the seeds each spring, I see them sprout, and it's a sight that warms the soul. Just like that bear, popping up when ye least expect it. It's a reminder of days gone by, of when the world was small and the worries even smaller. Saints be praised, such treasures do find their way home. Keep him close, and let the memories fill the hollows of your heart, much like a good harvest fills the barn.
